newsitem.title: USA: HOT STOCKS HIGHLIGHTS-Earnings propel share prices.
newsitem.headline: HOT STOCKS HIGHLIGHTS-Earnings propel share prices.

text.p: The stock climbed to a new high of 31-1/8 in heavy trading after the company posted second-quarter results far ahead of Wall Street expectations. The telecommunications company posted second-quarter net income of $0.21 per share compared to $0.12 per share last year. AirTouch also said it was on track to meet its fiscal year 1997 goal of $1.5 billion in operating cash flow. -------------------------------------------

Nellcor shares topped the most actives list on the Nasdaq after it agreed to be bought by Mallinckrodt Inc for about $1.9 billion. Shares of the medical device company hit a new high of 28-3/8 earlier in the day.

Shares rose after the company posted strong quarterly results mostly in line with analysts' estimates and strong profit margins. Digital, which reported fourth-quarter profit of $0.75 per share compared to a loss of $2.87 per share, also said it would buy back 15 million shares.
